Native CPI invoke and account-meta helper prototypes for native program calls.

# Purpose
This header declares the native CPI interface used by the Flamenco runtime to let native programs invoke other native programs. It includes the runtime, type, and VM syscall definitions needed for the function prototypes, and it uses include guards to prevent multiple inclusion. The main entry point is [`fd_native_cpi_native_invoke`](<#fd_native_cpi_native_invoke>), which takes an execution context, a native program ID, instruction data, account metadata, and signer keys, then performs the cross-program call. The file also declares [`fd_native_cpi_create_account_meta`](<#fd_native_cpi_create_account_meta>), which builds a VM account metadata record from a public key and signer or writable flags.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

- `fd_native_cpi_native_invoke`
- `fd_native_cpi_create_account_meta`
